name: bountypulse
description: Decentralized micro-bounty and escrow platform: Solidity settlement layer, IPFS storage layer, vanilla-JS DApp on Ethers.js v6.

comments.ethers: Pinned exactly, not '^6.13.4'. scripts/serve-frontend.sh copies dist/ethers.umd.min.js into frontend/vendor/ so the DApp runs offline; a floating range could swap that bundle underneath a working demo. The lockfile is committed for the same reason.
comments.no-bundler: The frontend is deliberately buildless: plain HTML/CSS/JS served statically, exactly as the specification requires. npm exists here only to vendor ethers and to alias the shell scripts.
